senses.gloss: Ex. (i) सर्वदर्शन सङ्ग्रह, आर्हत दर्शन, पृ० 21. (ii) नैष्कर्म्य सिद्धि 1.76. (iii) तन्त्रवार्तिक 1.3.8. A drowning man tries hard to save himself by catching whatever comes at hand in the water. He tries to hold even a blade of grass forgetting that it cannot be a proper support to save him. He tries hectically to save himself from drowning.
